description: Closes the seven gaps that kept the artificial-organism programme from being a closed autonomous loop: organism state (joucho mood / heartbeat cadence / posts / kaizen learning) persisted as-of queryable on the append-only kotoba Datom log; Murakumo-only narration with deterministic fail-open template; Wave-3 member-signed post drainer (serverHeldKey:false structural); Wave-4 kaizen outcome feedback (rule suppression + mood events).
